title: Pre-Market — Thursday, Nov 5, 2026
html:
Calm on top, chips cracking underneath. SPY is a touch higher before the bell, but yesterday's AI selloff got worse overnight.

The one thing

SPY is at $768.49, right on its $766–768 middle shelf. The question is whether it holds once the chip selling hits at 9:30. Qualcomm is down about 10%, Korea's chip stocks fell 5–9%, and MU, DELL and NVDA are below last night's lows. Holding $766 means the market is absorbing the selling. Losing $762 means it's spreading.

Overnight

  • Futures: S&P about flat to +0.1%, Nasdaq 100 −0.5 to −0.6%, Dow +0.5%. Pre-market: SPY +0.2%, QQQ −0.6%, IWM +0.4%.
  • Asia: Hong Kong +3%, Shanghai +3.6%. Kospi −4.5% (SK Hynix −9%), and Japan's chip names fell 10–12%.
  • Europe: the Bank of England hiked 0.25% to 4.0%.
  • WTI about $88 (+0.6%), Brent in the mid-$90s, 10-year yield about 4.84–4.89%, VIX about 16.9.
  • Trump tied the midterm loss to the Iran war, which feeds hopes for diplomacy.

SPY game plan

Levels: ceiling $774–776 · pre-market $768.49 · middle $766–768 · support $762–763 · gap top $757 · $752.30 · $744–748 · floor $722–727

  • Above $776: the ceiling is broken. Wait for 30 minutes above $774. Next stop is the $781.62 record.
  • Between $762 and $776 (most likely): chop, with $766–768 as the pivot. No SPY trade.
  • Below $762: expect a gap fill toward $757. Go defensive. This could bring the travel entries.

Movers (Watchlist)

  • MU $764.96 (−3.8%): broke the $782 low. The puts in budget are long shots, so no trade.
  • DELL $360.05 (−3.3%): broke the $366.62 low. Weak AI is confirmed. Skip the lottery puts.
  • NVDA $198.17 (−1.0%): closer to trigger, below $199.68. It needs a daily close below that. Low conviction, and earnings are Nov 17.
  • HLT $381.20 (+1.2%, thin volume): further from the $364.50–368.50 entry. Expedia is −5.9% despite beating and raising.
  • ABNB $177.00: reports tonight. IV-crush risk, and it's the read-through for HLT, RCL and DAL.
  • Also: BE −4.9%, AMD −3.6%, SMH −2.6%, SMCI −2.6%, PLTR −2.2%, TSLA −1.8%. Up: GOOGL +1.7%, AMZN +1.6%, AAPL +1.0% ($353.07). BA $177.68 is nearing the $181–185 put zone. NOW is flat.

Calendar (ET)

  • 8:30: jobless claims (forecast about 197K, prior 194K)
  • 9:10: Barkin
  • After the close: Airbnb, Affirm, Lyft, Akamai, Mattel. Logan at 7 p.m.
  • Fri 8:30: October jobs report (+65K, 4.2%)

Plays check (Options Playbook)

  • HLT Dec 18 $390 call: Wait. Entry on a pullback to $364.50–368.50. Cancel on a close below $359.41.
  • DAL Dec 18 $90 call: No change. It needs a close above $91.95, or a dip to $85–86. Cancel on a close below $83.
  • RCL Dec 18 $360 call: Wait. Entry on a dip to about $324.55. Cancel on a close below $318.
  • No new plays.

Opening rule

When the index is flat but the sectors are split, wait for the first 30-minute candle to close. If SPY's 30-minute candle closes above $766, buyers are absorbing the selling. If it closes below $762, they aren't. Don't buy HLT's thin pre-market gap.
